expectations: Superseded human approval without terminal timestamp is unavailable, never still ongoing or completed at generic updatedAt.
Retained vote identity becoming invalid makes its pending route stale/unavailable.
Same-run foreign-scope proposal/version records are excluded; retired current human cannot read.
Provider acceptance or fixture-bank settlement alone cannot close recovery before durable local matching/posting.
Matched completion stays fixed as asOf advances; a later return requires its own matched return endpoint for unresolved-outcome duration.
First failure recovery remains the first recovered episode after later return; do not silently redefine completed history.
Missing/future/reversed timestamps remain unavailable and excluded from measured duration aggregates; a recorded zero interval remains a legitimate completed sample.
